b: A film screening & three DJ sets have been planned to memorialise the "incredibly important" Michigan artist
Juan Atkins – techno's 'The Originator' who died at the end of last month – is being memorialised at an event held at New River Studios, Harringay on Friday night.

As well as DJ sets from tQ favourites UKAEA, Ruby Quick and Proteus, there will be a screening of the documentary The Last Angel Of History. John Akomfrah and Eddie George's documentary feature is a comment on and narrative thread in Afrofuturism, which, among many other things, encompasses Detroit techno.
